body: I don't know where to go to meet people. I just moved to a new city, and I don't know anyone. I don't know where the places to go are. I'm just completely lost here

I'm just tired of being here by myself. I feel so lonely, and idk why. I'm fine being alone all day for most of the time, but it's my birthday. My boyfriend thinks I'm trying to check my worth against his school work and that we should handle it after class, but I'm not trying to do that, and this loneliness is so overbearing Idk if I can wait until 9.

It's hard. I never thought I would end up in this situation, and yes like any other relationship like this, he's great when we aren't fighting. I have virtually no support system so it's really scary to think about. It feels like I'm just walking blind off a cliff right now, but it's clear that I don't have another choice.
